loginUi: [{"name": "账号", "type": "text"}, {"name": "密码", "type": "password"}, {"name": "登录", "type": "button", "action": "login()"}, {"name": "🔄 自动换域名", "type": "button", "action": "sethost()"}, {"name": "ℹ️ 当前域名", "type": "button", "action": "nowhost()"}]
loginUrl:
<js>
var B = "https://yushuwu.xyz";
try { var v = String(source.getVariable() || ""), hm = v.match(/host=([^\n;]+)/); if (hm) B = String(hm[1]).trim(); } catch (e) { }
B = B.replace(/\/+$/, '');
function login() {

  var map = source.getLoginInfoMap();
  var u = String(map["账号"] || ""), p = String(map["密码"] || "");
  if (u && p) {
    var page = java.ajax(String(B + "/user/"));
    var tok = String((String(page).match(/name="_token" value="([^"]+)"/) || [, ""])[1]);
    try {
      var oj = String(JSON.stringify({ headers: { "X-Requested-With": "XMLHttpRequest", "Referer": B + "/user/" } }));
      var t2 = JSON.parse(String(java.ajax(String(B + "/tool/getToken," + oj)))).token;
      if (t2 && String(t2).length > 10) tok = String(t2);
    } catch (e) { }
    var body = String("_token=" + encodeURIComponent(tok) + "&return_url=&username=" + encodeURIComponent(u) + "&password=" + encodeURIComponent(p) + "&captcha=&stay_logged_in=1");
    var opt = { method: "POST", body: body, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded", "X-Requested-With": "XMLHttpRequest", "Referer": B + "/user/" } };
    var res = JSON.parse(String(java.ajax(String(B + "/member/doLogin," + JSON.stringify(opt)))));
    java.longToast("[" + B + "] " + String(res.message || res.status));
  }
}
function savehost(u) { try { source.setVariable("host=" + String(u)); } catch (e) { } }
function sethost() {
  var cand = [], nav = "";
  try { nav = String(java.ajax("https://ifuwen2026.com/")); } catch (e) { }
  var re = /https?:\/\/([a-z0-9.-]*(?:yushuwu|wushuku|yanyan)[a-z0-9.-]*)/gi, m;
  while ((m = re.exec(nav)) !== null) { if (cand.indexOf(m[1]) < 0) cand.push(m[1]); }
  if (!cand.length) { cand = ["yushuwu.xyz", "wushuku.info", "wushuku.org"]; }
  var cur = B, ok = "", i, pg;
  java.longToast("当前域名：" + cur + "\n开始检测 " + cand.length + " 个候选…");
  for (i = 0; i < cand.length; i++) {
    java.longToast("检测 " + (i + 1) + "/" + cand.length + "：" + cand[i] + "\n当前：" + cur);
    try {
      pg = String(java.ajax("https://" + cand[i] + "/"));
      if (pg.indexOf("/sort/") >= 0 && pg.indexOf("耽美") >= 0) { ok = "https://" + cand[i]; break; }
    } catch (e) { }
  }
  if (!ok) {
    java.longToast("❌ 没找到可用域名，继续用：" + cur);
    return cur;
  }
  savehost(ok);
  java.longToast("✅ 已切到：" + ok + "\n原域名：" + cur + "\n正文空白请重新登录");
  return ok;
}
function nowhost() {
  java.longToast("当前域名：" + B + "\n（书源默认 https://yushuwu.xyz）");
  return B;
}

</js>
